records.statement: 重点戦略40KPIのうち、26KPIは基準値に対して向上、11KPIは基準値に対して低下と公式ページが公表。残る3KPIの区分はこのHTML集計だけから推測しない。
records.evidence_location: 重点戦略（まち・ひと・しごと創生総合戦略）の進捗状況
records.review_note: 40-26-11=3という算術残数は保持するが、横ばい・未集計など具体的状態を公式個票確認なしに割り当てない。

quality_boundary: This initial Saitama Phase 13 package separates the current 2021-2030 basic plan, current 2026-2030 implementation plan, historical 2021-2025 implementation cycle, fiscal-2024 progress evaluation, and fiscal states. The 370 project evaluation universe is an occurrence count including reposted projects; the official report states 299 unique projects after deduplication. Municipality A/B/C and measure progress labels are source-reported internal evaluations, not Jichi Insight achievement judgments. Current-plan subjective and objective outcome indicators remain separate measurement families, and no outcome change is promoted to causal effect or cross-city comparability.
next_action: Enumerate the current 2026-2030 implementation-plan project identities and outcome indicators from official PDFs, preserving duplicate/repost semantics and subjective/objective measurement lanes. Then review the historical 2024 individual project/measure evidence only where it can be linked without crossing the implementation-cycle boundary.
